notes: Fix incomplete Japanese localization when switching language. Many scene-card labels (Align H/V, Text align, Text style, Show at/Hide at, Font, Glow, Stroke, Block BG, Exact volume, Blur, etc.) are built with bare ${t.xxx} and no data-i18n attribute, so setAppLang never re-translated them — they stayed frozen at their build-time (English) language. Added switchLang(): the language toggles (main switcher + Timeline editor) now re-translate the static chrome AND rebuild the loaded scene cards via loadSegments, so every dynamic label re-resolves in the new language (editor stays on the selected scene/layer). Also gave the hardcoded 'Box r:' / 'Block r:' radius labels real i18n keys (label_box_r / label_block_r). Verified EN→JA→EN round-trip leaves zero untranslated labels across all card sections.
